verdict.rationale: Algolia's InstantSearch libraries directly support faceted navigation via refinementList and other facet widgets, backed by dedicated docs on browse & navigation/faceted filtering and quickstart examples that filter by product type; the API itself computes facet counts as part of a single query response. Community feedback corroborates ease of building rich search UIs (React InstantSearch praised) though some note relevance/scale caveats unrelated to faceting itself. Missing for 10: no explicit doc snippet showing live facet counts across ranges (numeric refinement) combined with categories in one example, and no independent hands-on benchmark of faceted count accuracy.
